rationale: C23 supplies an exceptionally close two-sentence template: the same first-person designation of a named organization as a public international organization entitled to statutory privileges, followed by the same non-abridgment proviso concerning privileges acquired by treaty or congressional action. C06 and C04 use substantially the same machinery and language, but C23 most closely matches the child's singular-organization formulation without additional operative material.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the Intergovernmental Maritime Consultative Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative sentence is virtually identical, with only the organization name and the minor word “said” changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the Intergovernmental Maritime Consultative Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which that organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: The complete second-sentence proviso follows the same sequence and nearly identical wording, strongly indicating reuse of a concrete drafting template.
